{{Quote|At the Academy, we all heard stories about '''Darth Vader'''. The cadets were '''terrified''' of the Emperor's enforcer. They called him ''"the Warlock"'' -- claimed that he '''murdered''' Imperial officers for his own pleasure. But when Lord Vader come to our aid in the courtyard, I realized that serving him could earn an officer the only two things that matter...'''fear and respect'''.|Laurita Tohm|<ref name="Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 1">[[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 1|''Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison'' 1]]</ref>}}
A '''military revolt''' was orchestrated on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by [[Headmaster/Legends|Headmaster]] [[Gentis]] during his attempted [[Ghost Prison incident|coup]]. Gentis successfully took control of Coruscant for a brief time, but was [[Battle on Coruscant|defeated]] shortly afterward.

==Prelude==
Though the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] had ended, many Imperial soldiers kept dying because of the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] warmongering, a fact that led the [[Headmaster/Legends|Headmaster]] of the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]], [[Gentis]], to launch an coup, with the goal of killing the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and stopping the endless killing that cost him all but one of his sons. Using his position, the Headmaster struck the night of the graduation of the first class of [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]].

==Revolt==
{{Quote|You '''couldn't''' be involved&mdash;you always draw too much attention. But you can stand with us '''now'''. Kill Darth Vader and the Empire is '''ours'''.''"<br />"''You should have asked me '''yesterday'''.|Shens pleads with Tohm before the latter executes him|<ref name="Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 2">[[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 2|''Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison'' 2]]</ref>}}
Explosions rocked the cityscape for [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] around, eliminating seventy-two Imperial targets within minutes. The officer's club, various [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] garrisons, the Comm Towers, and a supply depot were all destroyed. [[Imperial Plaza (Imperial Palace)|Imperial Plaza]] became ground zero in the battle that erupted, as "terrorist" forces swarmed through the city streets, fighting with the Empire's [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] forces. The stormtroopers were losing the battle until the "[[Warlock]]," [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader,]]<ref name="kenner" /> appeared, rallying the troops and driving the enemy forces back. In the madness, Tohm had escaped from the prototype [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] by engaging its [[Ejector seat/Legends|ejection seat]] and landing in the midst of the battle. Tohm joined the stormtroopers in following Vader, but when one of the terrorists grabbed his ankle, he bent and removed the man's mask, revealing his friend Shens. Shens begged Tohm to help them kill Palpatine, the main target of their [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempts that night.

[[File:ThePrism.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Palpatine escaped to a hidden Jedi prison, the Prism.]]
As Shens lay dying, he then asked Tohm to kill Vader, but Tohm told his friend that he should have included him earlier, and shot Shens in the head. The lieutenant then bowed to the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], who instantly respected his bravery and loyalty. As the pair made their way from the plaza, another explosion tore through the nearby buildings, unleashing a powerful necrotic virus known as [[Aorth-6]]. Dozens of Imperials, including [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guardsmen]], were killed by the aerosolized virus, which liquified them from the inside out. Lieutenant Tohm donned a breathing device that he had taken from the TIE fighter when he ejected and followed [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Vader inside. There they found a mortally infected Emperor Palpatine and Moff [[Trachta]]. Palpatine was using the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] to keep the virus at bay, but was losing the battle even with his formidable powers. Vader accused Trachta of being part of the conspiracy, but the Moff vehemently denied it, saying they needed to get the Emperor into hiding; fear of his power was the only thing keeping the Empire together. The trio escorted the sovereign to secret [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] below the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]], where they loaded him aboard a stealth transport.
